title: cyathea decomposita
intro: Cyathea decomposita, commonly known as the Table Fern, is a species of fern native to Australia. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, which include its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Cyathea decomposita include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties, which help to soothe and protect the skin. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
